verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents downloading a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, which covers spreadsheet export. Its marketing mentions a board deck drafted off last night's numbers, but never says that deck can be exported to a slide format. The read-only report link is sharing, not export, and earns no credit. Missing for 10: PDF export, documented slide/deck file export, export of full reports rather than single Pages, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
